approved_scope.title: The workflow-v1 cutoff check reports an unreadable archive tree as a read failure, not as an absent change
approved_scope.description: The workflow-v1 cutoff check reports an unreadable archive tree as a read failure, not as an absent change
acceptance_criteria: A cutoff with no archive root at all still has no archived candidates and gives the same verdict as today
The error is never cached: only a conclusive presence is stored under the cutoff, as before

an_unreadable_cutoff_archive_tree_is_an_error_not_an_absent_change passes: in an offline --filter=tree:0 clone whose cutoff archive tree was never fetched, the cutoff-tree check returns an error saying the archive tree at the cutoff could not be read, instead of Ok(false) (committed failing first in 45ef2006)
cutoff_tree_verdict_equals_the_history_walk_verdict and every existing refusal stay unchanged; no gate or bound is weakened

answers.constraints: SPEED-1.a.3 (an unreadable history is reported as unreadable, not as absent); REQ-change-136 stays; the partial-clone rule that an unreadable listed object is never treated or cached as absent (an_unreadable_blob_at_a_commit_is_an_error_not_an_absent_file); change.3md 'Finalize judges only what it archives'
